responsibilities: Lead end-to-end service delivery across Agency and Broker lifecycle operations for 105 clients and 405 professionals, ensuring SLA adherence, backlog management, service continuity and escalation resolution.

Drive portfolio-wide operational governance through KPI reviews, capacity/workforce planning, productivity, quality, TNA, capability building, data-driven decision making, cost management and account growth.
Manage strategic client relationships through governance calls and QBRs, identifying operational improvement, transformation and growth opportunities.
Lead Process Excellence, operating-model design, business transformation and digital initiatives across the insurance value chain.
Conduct process mapping and gap analysis; identify improvement opportunities, develop use cases and present scope, cost-benefit and transformation cases to clients.
Design business and functional solution architectures for AI and automation initiatives; translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions.
Lead automation from opportunity assessment and POC through UAT, deployment, governance and benefit realisation; drive adoption of RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI.
Lead change management and stakeholder engagement to drive adoption of operational excellence, automation and AI-led transformation.
Led end-to-end service delivery for 101 clients and 375 professionals with portfolio governance across KPI, capacity, productivity, quality, capability building, cost and account growth.
Led Process Excellence and transformation initiatives by identifying high-impact opportunities and developing use cases across the process value chain.
Applied Lean and Six Sigma to identify operational risks, design operating models and drive process improvements supporting strategic business decisions.
Developed functional AI solution architecture and partnered with automation teams to implement intelligent automation; established automation governance and monitored ROI.
Managed multi-functional Service Delivery and Quality operations for 95 clients and 310 professionals.
Drove Lean management and process optimisation to improve productivity, reduce waste and enhance service quality.
Used KPI trends, capacity planning, productivity tracking, quality analysis and corrective actions to drive operational improvements.
Led client governance, transformation discussions, service improvements and capability-building initiatives.
Managed Agency and Broker lifecycle operations across multiple clients and teams, with responsibility for SLA/KPI performance, productivity, quality, client communication and escalation management.

KEY BUSINESS IMPACT
GenAI integration in renewal policy comparison for 30 clients: 70% efficiency improvement, capacity equivalent to 12 FTEs/week and $350K annualised savings.
GenAI integration in Direct Bill Reconciliation for 75 clients: 58% efficiency improvement, capacity equivalent to 10 FTEs/week and $34K annualised savings.
DMAIC-led policy issuance improvement: TAT reduced from 10.8 to 6.52 days (35.9% improvement), process capability improved from 2.6σ to 3.8σ and $3.8M annualised savings.
Quality transformation across 125 P&C insurance clients: accuracy improved from 95% to 99%, process capability improved from 3.33σ to 4.6σ, QA coverage reduced by 70% and $365,100 annual savings.
Lean-based improvement in non-client delivery work: cycle time reduced by 28%, efficiency improved from 24% to 42% and 3.5 hours/person/week saved.
